notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.4.0
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch 1.4.0

Features:
-Added Developer Comments: You can read various developer comments by clicking on developer comment nodes scattered around the map, but you must first turn them on from the in game menu. The comments contain various behind-the-scenes stories and development anecdotes. Some of them contain spoilers so it is recommended you only view them after finishing the game.

Bug fixes:
-Some small fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.3.0
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch 1.3.0

Features:
-Added an Inventory System. You can place up to 6 items in the inventory, and it is shared between players in multiplayer.
-Added new background music.
-Improved voice acting.

General Changes:
-Adjusted how pick up-able items are highlighted.
-Adjusted Footsteps to be more quiet.
-Adjusted the sound of the rain to be slightly more quiet.

Bug fixes:
-Fixed zooming on inspected items working incorrectly on extreme frame rates.
-Other small fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch 1.2.0

Features:
-Added Item Descriptions: you can now see the name and the description of an item when you inspect it.

General Changes:
-Reworked the in-game cursor movement to match  the operating system cursor.
-Adjusted the marbles to be shinier
-Adjusted most notes and books to be a bit bigger.
-Other small tweaks.

Bug fixes:
-Fixed a typo
-Various small fixes

tags.feature: -Added Item Descriptions: you can now see the name and the description of an item when you inspect it.

tags.balance_change: -Adjusted most notes and books to be a bit bigger.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch 1.1.0

Features:
-Added the ability to inspect items carried by other players.

Puzzle adjustments:
-Improved the controls of the sliding puzzle in the workshop.

General changes:
-Re-baked lighting to fix lighting and shadow artifacts, as well as increasing the sharpness of certain shadows.
-Optimized files to reduce install size.
-Some small QoL changes

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed some typos.
-Shifted some small environmental objects that were incorrectly place, such as certain door hinges.
-Other small fixes

tags.feature: -Added the ability to inspect items carried by other players.

tags.bug: -Shifted some small environmental objects that were incorrectly place, such as certain door hinges.

tags.balance_change: -Re-baked lighting to fix lighting and shadow artifacts, as well as increasing the sharpness of certain shadows.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Here is the change log for patch 1.0.1

Puzzle adjustments:
-Added second flashlight to the toolbox, so that, in multiplayer, more than one player can solve the storage room together.
-Reworded couple of hints, as well as adding a few new ones
-Made the small vases a bit smaller to make it clear that they are, in fact, small
-Adjusted the glass shader of project Wheatstone to make the letters bit easier to see.

General changes:
-Adjusted the opening animations of books slightly
-Made the sound of thunder a bit more quiet
-Added a sound for giving the wooden toy to the cat
-Some various small QoL changes

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed some typos and some grammar issues
-Fixed collision of books, making them easier to pickup
-Adjusted the collision of the scales to make it easier to place objects near it
-Fixed a bug where when placing objects the red outline of the object would show when it shouldn't
